desc:
Grab up to 3 friends, hop on a raft and race down a wild jungle river powered by the strongest engine known to hippo-kind… FARTS! 💨🌊

🦛 Each crew member controls one side of the raft. Spin to your spot, aim your rear, and BLAST off!
🔥 Don’t overheat! Too much tooting and you’ll need to cool down 😳
🔨 Dodge swinging hammers, spinning rotors, spiky buoys and crushing gates
🎨 Unlock new fart styles ✨
💾 Save your run and come back anytime

👫 Play solo or team up with friends. Teamwork makes the dream work… and the farts stronger 💪💨

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
